newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves funds for Papua New Guinea.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves funds for Papua New Guinea.

text.p: The World Bank said it approved release of a $25 million second tranche of an economic recovery program loan to Papua New Guinea.
The $50 million overall loan, the first tranche of which was approved in 1995, was designed to promote long-term economic stability as well as sustainable and equitable growth, the Bank said.
Reforms are focused on restoring and maintaining macroeconomic stability and achieving a more equitable allocation of resources for basic services such as health and education.
In addition, the country is seeking to improve infrastructure and promoting evironmentally sustainable growth and development, the Bank added.
